implementation: New connector-authored recovery implementation; not claimed byte-identical to files in the unavailable cloud environment.
reason: Post-observation diagnostic for predecessor/cache confounding in cyclic interleaved timing; not preregistration.
hardware_policy: Use the successful new main execution's one-CPU affinity and observed runtime; never pool old interrupted-host observations.
freeze_policy: After all three new main repetitions succeed, freeze their input/verification hashes, identical saved oracle, runtime, source hashes and numeric evidence into lock.json. Detect changes throughout all six workers.
process_policy: One new subprocess, one engine, one measured complete-video pass. No ANN index is constructed.
warmup: Prepare the same immutable candidate descriptors; use only first, middle and last catalog records as three warmup queries, then reset.
timed: engine search, top-k and history maintenance
returned indexes and scores converted to Python lists
oracle_policy: Only the frozen saved new-main oracle is used for validation, after each query timer. No competing engine is run to grade the measured engine.
publication: Publish numeric summaries/CSV/report only. Per-query JSONL contains no candidate ID or score arrays; raw matches remain in a separate NPZ. Print compact numeric CONTROL_SUMMARY_BEGIN/END in logs.
interpretation: Two original-order repetitions per engine; one shuffled-order supplementary repetition. One existing composited clip. No confidence intervals, significance claims or cross-video generalization. Keep new-main interleaved and isolated results separate.
